prompt: Create a transparent six-view character turnaround atlas in exact 6 columns by 3 rows. Columns, in order: FRONT, TOP, RIGHT SIDE, LEFT SIDE, BOTTOM, REAR. Rows, in order, are the 3 attached 128x128 pixel-art source characters: Donut (crowned lavender character with dark curled side tail), Alchemist (brown-haired green-clad character with a small green alchemy bottle), Cleric (gray hood and robe with gold-tipped staff). Preserve each character's exact identity, outfit colors, pixel-art style, chunky 1-2 pixel dark outline, and standing neutral pose. Every cell must show the SAME character and same standing pose from the named orthographic direction. Hard pixel edges, no smoothing, no gradients, no shadows, no cell borders, no labels, equal scale and centered whole figure. Orthographic principal directions only: top is straight down onto crown/head and shoulders, bottom is straight up to shoe soles and underside of body with face fully occluded (no reclining person), side cells show true left/right profile, rear shows back of head/clothing. No three-quarter perspective and no isometric view. Leave generous transparent margin in every square cell; do not crop any silhouette.
